## "camera_setting_control"

**Data type:**  
String

**Value:**  
cam1.4, cam1.4_error or null

**Description of metadata field:**  
This indicates if the cameras exif data falls into certain predetermined categories. These categories need to be determined.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Processing module on hpc server. Reads from exif data and checks against a list of values. 

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
Integration server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
camera_setting_control

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
Missing implementation and list of camera settings to check against.
